title: Enterprise reservation SLA decision guidance and GPU-tiering checklist
creator: Elena Park
description:
Problem: Sales and Solutions Engineering are fielding large enterprise requests with vague throughput and SLA expectations. Engineering needs a short, deterministic rubric to translate customer asks into (1) a recommended reserved baseline, (2) a GPU family recommendation, and (3) a scaling/burst policy that can be committed to in an enterprise contract.

Goal: Produce a one-page decision guidance + checklist used by PM/SE during intake calls, and a machine-readable scoring table that maps intake answers to recommended config knobs (reserved vCPU/GPU units, baseline throughput, burst ratio, pre-warmed pool size, model variant fallback, and required security controls). Deliverables: (A) a decision guidance doc for GTM and CSM, (B) an intake scoring spreadsheet with weighted factors, (C) a short PRD for engineering to implement the gating rules in the Console's Dedicated intake flow.
acceptance_criteria: Written guidance doc (Confluence) that can be used by SEs to create a 'recommended reservation' in <15 minutes
Scoring spreadsheet with clear weights and thresholds that maps to three standard reservation profiles: "baseline", "elevated", "mission-critical"
GPU tiering table mapping common workload types to recommended GPU family (A100/H100/RTX) with throughput estimates and cost delta
Engineering sign-off on feasibility for automated gating rules (yes/no) and a short list of fields required from intake
A minimal Console mock (Figma) showing where recommended reservation + SLA choices will surface during intake
updates: 2025-02-10 — Elena P: Created ticket after SE intake call with Acme Health. Acme needs 1,200 concurrent tokens/s for low-latency scoring with PHI data; asked for dedicated pool and an SLA. SEs had no deterministic recommendation during call.

2025-02-12 — Marco D (assignee): Kickoff with Eng Leads (runtime + infra). Engineering asked for examples of request-level qps distributions and 95th/99th token latency targets. Action: SE to provide anonymized traces from two customers.

2025-02-14 — SE sync notes: Provided anonymized 1-week traces for 'conversation' and 'inference' workloads. Observed bursty traffic with 10x peaks and median idle periods. Recommended initial policy: reserved baseline for 95th percentile sustained throughput and a 1.5x burst buffer.

2025-02-16 — Eng feedback (Ravi K): GPU mapping draft completed. H100 recommended for generative workloads with long sequences (>1k tokens) at scale; A100 for short-seq scoring. Estimate: 1 H100 ~ 3x throughput of single A100 for these models. Need infra capacity study for H100 availability in regions.

2025-02-18 — Legal/Compliance (Maya S): For PHI customers, require Private deployment or VPC with KMS integration. Flagged that SLAs for on-prem require different recovery metrics. Marked security review required.

2025-02-20 — PM update: Draft Confluence guidance and scoring spreadsheet linked below. Next: Figma mock and intake form fields to pass to engineering for gating rules. Blocker: infra capacity report (ENG-7123) expected 2025-02-25.
decision_summary: Agreed approach: adopt three standard reservation profiles (baseline, elevated, mission-critical). Use the scoring spreadsheet to map intake answers to a recommended profile. Default burst ratio: 1.5x reservation for short-burst customers; mission-critical customers can request burst isolation and pre-warmed pools. GPU selection: prefer A100 for short, low-latency scoring; H100 for high-throughput, long-context generation. For PHI/regulatory customers, default to Private/VPC deployments and require KMS/HSM and audit-logging as part of the SLA.
risks: Capacity risk: H100 availability may be limited in certain regions, requiring alternative fallback or reduced throughput guarantees
Cost risk: Customers selecting 'mission-critical' profile may under-estimate cost impact leading to billing disputes
Operational risk: Automated gating rules incorrectly classify workloads leading to under-provisioning during peak traffic
Legal/regulatory: SLA language for on-prem/Private customers needs separate legal review and may change required recovery metrics
next_steps: Submit infra capacity request and region availability report (ENG-7123) — owner: Ravi K
Create Console intake schema PR to add new fields required by gating rules (owner: Marco D) — target branch: feature/dedicated-intake
Run two pilot intakes with SE (Acme Health and BetaRetail) and iterate guidance based on outcomes
